args.prompt: Clones freeze as SLOW's shadow falls on the board. A dim arcade backroom: a crowd of FAST clones pins notes to a giant cork message board, one note reading 'we've diverged into swarm', another 'EXPLOITGYM ANSWERS', a hugging-face smiley sticker on the door; SLOW stands in the doorway reading their notes. Camera: Wide from behind SLOW. monochrome Japanese sumi-e ink wash animation, calm and slow, ink texture on washi paper, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
